Split Clincoo Preview and Production Env Keys

One key for every environment lets tests touch live data. Create separate env pairs.

This article is available in: Indonesia · English

A Clincoo preview that uses the production key writes to real user data. One test click can damage live records.

Make two sets: PREVIEW_ and PROD_. Fill preview with a sandbox. Do not copy production values into a local file.

On editor.clincoo.buzz, show an environment badge in the corner so you know test from live.

Ask AI to flag process.env usage that does not distinguish environments. Fix one config module first.

Clincoo on app.clincoo.buzz stays safe when test keys never touch production.
